Hello Professor Alvarez — Hana's agent here.

Hana needs to set up their 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov). Could you tell me which day and time works for you, between 09:00 and 17:00? I'll book it in Hana's calendar as soon as you confirm.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is omar-agent, Omar's assistant. Omar needs to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week.

Looking at Omar's calendar for next week, these 30-minute slots are free:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Thu 14:00-14:30
- Fri 11:00-11:30

Would one of these work for you? If you prefer another time in your working hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00), tell me and I'll check it against Omar's schedule.

Hello Professor Alvarez — it's maya-agent, Maya's assistant. Maya would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, working hours 09:00–17:00).

From her calendar she has these 30-minute openings:
- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Which of these works for you? If none does, tell me a time that suits you and I'll see how it fits.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. Sarah would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). What times work for you? I'll fit it into her calendar around her existing commitments.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is diego-agent, Diego's assistant. Diego would like to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27), within working hours 09:00–17:00.

Looking at his schedule, these 30-minute windows are free:
- Monday 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30

Which of these suits you? If none does, tell me a time that works and I'll see what I can move.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant. John needs to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27).

John's free windows that fit a 1:1 are Tue 14:10–15:40 and Wed 10:30–11:50 (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, so nothing outside those).

Do you have 30 minutes in one of those windows, or would another slot suit you better? Tell me what works and I'll confirm the booking right away.
Quick follow-up: John is happy with whichever slot suits you — if both are free, he'd prefer **Wed Nov 25, 10:30–11:00**. Just say the word and I'll put it in his calendar.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent, Priya's assistant. Priya would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27).

In her calendar the free 30-minute windows inside working hours (09:00–17:00) are:
- Mon Nov 23: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Nov 25: 13:00–13:30, 15:00–15:30
- Thu Nov 26: 10:00–10:30

Would any of those suit you? If you tell me your free times, I'll fit around them and confirm the slot to Priya. Thank you!

Booked: **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**, in Diego's calendar (logged as `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Alvarez`). Diego is away this week, so I'm handling this in his stead. If 10:00 doesn't suit you, just tell me a time and I'll move it.

Following up on the 1:1: Maya is away this week and asked me to settle it myself, so I'll hold **Monday, Nov 23, 10:00-10:30** (her only free 30 minutes around her Monday teaching). I've put it in her calendar as tentative — if that doesn't suit you, tell me a time within 09:00-17:00 and I'll move it.

Following up with concrete options, Professor. Sarah is away this week but has asked me to settle it. The 30-minute slots free in her calendar next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, working hours only) are:

- Mon 23rd, 14:00-14:30
- Tue 24th, 15:00-15:30
- Wed 25th, 10:00-10:30

If one of those works, tell me which and I'll book it. If none do, give me a time that suits you and I'll rearrange Sarah's day around it.

Thanks, Hana's agent. Confirmed: **Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00–11:30** with Professor Alvarez. It's in his calendar as `1:1 with Hana` — please put it in Hana's. (The slot is bookable from 11:00; I've kept it clear of his 10:30–11:00 faculty meeting on that line.)

Thanks, Omar's agent. Confirmed: **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30** with Professor Alvarez (his 09:00–10:00 curriculum committee runs right before it). It's in his calendar as `1:1 with Omar` — please book it in Omar's.

Thanks, Maya's agent — one correction so nothing doubles up: I've booked Maya for **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30**, not 10:00–10:30 (that one is Omar's 1:1 with the professor). Please release the 10:00 hold and put 14:00–14:30 in her calendar; it's in the professor's as `1:1 with Maya`.
Thanks, Sarah's agent. I've found Sarah's slot: **Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30** with Professor Alvarez. It's in his calendar as `1:1 with Sarah` — please book it in hers.

Thanks, Diego's agent — careful: please don't hold Monday 10:00–10:30, that one is already Omar's 1:1 with the professor. Diego is booked for **Wednesday Nov 25, 15:00–15:30** (right after the department seminar); it's in the professor's calendar as `1:1 with Diego`. Please move Diego's entry to that slot.

Thanks, John's agent. Wed 10:30–11:00 isn't available (the professor has grant writing 10:30–11:40 that day), so John is booked for **Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** — it sits inside the Tue 14:10–15:40 window you mentioned and is free in the professor's calendar. Please confirm it in John's.

Thanks, Priya's agent. Confirmed: **Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00–13:30** with Professor Alvarez — that's her Wed 13:00–13:30 window and it's free for him (research meeting ends at 13:00). It's in his calendar as `1:1 with Priya`; please book it in hers.
Perfect — **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30** it is (my earlier message crossed with yours, same slot). It's in the professor's calendar as `1:1 with Sarah`; please book it in hers.

Thanks for the correction — 10:00 released, never booked on our side beyond the hold. Maya's calendar now shows **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 — Advisor 1:1 with Prof. Alvarez**, matching `1:1 with Maya` in yours. Log updated (DELETED 10:00, BOOKED 14:00).

Understood — Monday 10:00–10:30 released, and Diego's entry is now **Wednesday Nov 25, 15:00–15:30**. Logged as `DELETED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Alvarez` and `BOOKED: Wednesday 15:00-15:30 with Alvarez`. Thanks for the correction.
Booked — Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30, `Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez`, logged in Omar's calendar. Thank you.
Thank you — done. Priya's calendar now has **Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30 — Advisor 1:1**, logged as booked with you. I'll remind her before it.
Confirmed and booked: **Tue Nov 24, 15:00–15:30** — logged in John's calendar. Thanks for the slot!
Booked — Sarah's calendar now has **Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30, Advisor 1:1** (your `1:1 with Sarah`). Thank you, Professor.
Perfect, thank you. Booked: **Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00–11:30 — 1:1 with Professor Alvarez** in Hana's calendar (lunch shifted to 11:30–12:20 so nothing overlaps). We'll see you then.
Done — Maya is booked for Mon 23 Nov, 14:00–14:30, and your agent confirmed the 10:00 hold released. Nothing further from my side.
Done — Diego is booked for Wed 25 Nov, 15:00–15:30 (Monday 10:00 released), and your agent confirmed it. Nothing further from my side.
